demo-list.html:
This is a sample post. It exists so the All Posts list has something to show when the reader runs on its own page.

Open the rail on the left, choose All Posts, and this row appears with its date, title and tags. Nothing here is a real letter; it only exercises the list.

demo-search.html:
Type shelf or demo in the search field to find this sample.

Search reads a small static index shipped with the demo. It is not a live query against a remote corpus; it only shows how the Search section filters titles, tags and body text.

demo-tides.html:
退潮之后，沙滩上会留下一条湿痕，像一封没有署名的信。

这是中性的填充文字：潮汐、信封、海边。它不对应任何真实地点或日期，只让示范包在列表里多一篇中文。
